title: results.json
description: One student's scores for the conversations in data/conversations.json. Two rules cannot be written in JSON Schema and are checked by viewer.html: every result lists the same criteria in the same order, and overall is the average of that result's scores, rounded to two decimals.

results.description: One entry per scored conversation. A conversation that could not be scored is left out.

overall.description: The average of this conversation's scores, rounded to two decimals.

scores.description: One entry per criterion of the rubric, in the rubric's order.

criterion.description: The criterion's name: its heading in rubric.md.

reason.description: One sentence from the judge giving the evidence for the score.
